head: ImagineSleep helps you fall asleep with the cognitive shuffle
dek: ImagineSleep is built around the cognitive shuffle, a bedtime technique where you picture unrelated everyday things one at a time; you build the list yourself. It was #30 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It came out on 4 November and costs $2.99, by Blake Nicole Tracy.
means: If your mind races at night, it guides you through a simple picture-by-picture routine.
todo: Find ImagineSleep in the App Store.
thumb_words: A NEW TRICK TO FALL ASLEEP
